name: spatial-collab
description: Explore paired spatial RNA and protein data with shared selections, annotation revisions and reproducible descriptive comparisons.

interface.shortDescription: Review spatial data together and test annotation sensitivity.
interface.longDescription: A local research alpha with home, RNA and protein workspaces, exact paired objects, reversible annotation revisions and reproducible region comparisons. Descriptive evidence only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my Spatial Collab project, inspect the selected cells and markers, propose a revision, and compare the neighborhood result after my confirmation.
